limitations: Current rank does not measure historical opponent version strength.
131 list rows lack maps, opponent submission IDs and engine-side coordinates; historical match IDs/terminations are joined when verified, remaining status is unknown.
Latest errors are team-round totals, not proof of a forfeit in our match.
Round1 now contains6 matches while the older snapshot contained5; do not silently reuse old denominator.
Wilson intervals are descriptive independent-Bernoulli summaries and do not correct clustered/nonrandom Swiss schedules.
Common-team bootstrap is conditional on observed teams; periods and opponent upgrades remain confounded.
No full all-team fixture graph, so no identifiable opponent-adjusted Bradley-Terry recommendation is fit.
8+11 pooling is a same-source time sensitivity; the opponent pool and time differ.
